'''Armavolve''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Borelord]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Armavolve is secretly using those massive claws to drill all the way to the Earth's core. It's time for the entire planet to get overhauled!"

Armavolve is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Armavolve was added to the game on 10/7/2026 alongside [[Popa]] and [[Cactobodhi]].
